# CI — the evidentiary standard, enforced.
#
# The scope appendix says twelve capabilities are "built, tested, and active on
# signature". Until 2026-09-02 the test harness could not execute; until this
# file, nothing ran it automatically. A suite nobody runs on every commit is a
# suite whose green is a memory.
#
# Two jobs, on purpose. Typecheck and tests fail independently, so a red run says
# WHICH standard slipped rather than one bar going red for both.
name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: ['**']
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  typecheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run typecheck

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      # `vitest run`, never watch mode; exit code propagates. No `| tail`.
      - run: npm test
